sec.title: September 1 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 574)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 1** across British radio adaptations of classic science fiction and historical drama, romantic American operettas, and modern syndicated western and mystery audio dramas, H.G. Wells's *The Island of Dr. Moreau* on the BBC (1990), Reginald De Koven's *Robin Hood* on *Palmolive Beauty Box Theater* (1937), *The Running of the Deer* (1979), *The Legion of the Lost* (1984), and Jim French's *Imagination Theatre* (1937–2002):
